title: Greek Lamb Kebabs
description: Tender and flavorful lamb kebabs, marinated in classic Greek seasonings, perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the lamb, onion, and olives onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Season the skewers with salt and pepper.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and garnish with parsley.
Serve immediately, with a side of your favorite Greek salad or roasted vegetables.
